key_concepts: The periodic table is organized into groups (columns) and periods (rows)
An element's group number and period number give its location in the periodic table
Elements can be classified as representative, transition, or inner transition
Groups in the periodic table have common names or family names
Element symbols such as Au, Ne, Co, and Fr correspond to specific element names
Examples of elements include lithium, gold, selenium, neon, europium, californium, cobalt,
Knowing an element's group and period helps describe its placement in the periodic table
